newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Qian says HK legislature constituted.
newsitem.headline: China's Qian says HK legislature constituted.

text.p: Foreign Minister Qian Qichen on Saturday declared that the provisional legislature to be installed in Hong Kong next July had been duly constituted.
Qian said on live television from the city in China's southern Guangdong province that a 400-member Selection Committee had elected the 60-seat legislature in a "just, fair and open" ballot.
The legislature, filled with pro-Beijing figurees, will replace Hong Kong's elected Legislative Council when China resumes control of Hong Kong from Britain at midnight on June 30.
Britain has questioned the legislature's conformity with the treaty governing the handover and challenged China to take the issue to the world court in the Hague, Netherlands.
